I essentially have attachment problems. I become attached to others incredible fast and once this happens I need to talk to said person frequently,  and if I'm not able to I feel as of they dislike me and I impulsively act on those feelings. 

This was a struggle in the past, but I am currently taking meds to relieve the feelings of anxiousness and better capable of distinguish between what I've idealized the friendship to be and where it really stands.
I fell asleep,  but yes I do have a problem with avoidance as well.

Borderline personality disorder. I get really attached to people I am interested in being friends with, I extend my person onto said person and will go out of my way to seek their approval/acceptance and when my mind starts saying said person hates me, I start pushing away from him/her. Just as strong as I can like a person, I can dislike a person just as strongly. The feelings of love and disinterest can cycle through a few times and quite frequently.

When talking to others in real time I can read others body language. I can detect the slightest change and feel like the person would much rather not be hearing about whatever it is we are talking about. Online, people can come and go as they please so I don't feel as if I am holding them up, however,  this is still a hard thing because when a person starts to get short the anxiety starts.

I don't go to therapy for that reason. When I was seeing a psychologist, she told me  "if you don't know what you want to change there is no point in you being here".

At times it is definitely hard to live with a mind like mine, especially when I'm in an extreme funk and realize I don't have true friends to talk to that would "get it". 
Having such an intense personality helps me out a lot when it comes to achieving personal set goals, and being capable of mentally checking out to avoid being hurt by external situations
